statements.status_notes: The images include mtr 0.95. MTR_PACKET can select an executable, with security impact when mtr is launched in a privileged context such as sudo. Upstream fixed the behavior in mtr 0.96. The images do not establish a sudo launch policy, and privileged launch scenarios and a compatible packaged update remain under investigation. See https://github.com/traviscross/mtr/commit/5226f105f087c29d3cfad9f28000e7536af91ac6 and https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2025-49809
